18 risers, tread/landing dimensions and a real slab void coordinated; structural waist/beam/guard details and finished headroom need professional checking.
Static vehicle fits with a clear right approach. Driving/turning/gate operation still unverified.
NBC 205 coverage cap 92.90304 m2 is exceeded; use project-specific NBC 105 engineering. Missing M08 is excluded, not an active dependency.

Owner confirmed GF enlarged common bathroom opens ONLY into lounge; 950 mm slider is provisional. Validate elder-accessible clear opening, turning/fixtures, wet-area privacy. Bedroom 2 lounge entry remains unconfirmed circulation candidate.

Owner confirmed exactly ONE internal glazed Bed 2/stair-wall opening centred on FF-STAIR-REAR-1, 900×1100 mm provisional. Fire/privacy/safe glazing review required. Internal FF lounge-side bedroom door position owner confirmed, right zero-setback exterior wall stays closed. Main-bedroom aluminum windows and piers still provisional.
Unpriced architectural deltas only. No accepted quantities, rates, project schedule start, activity durations or construction-issued work packages.

GF bedroom/kitchen to bathroom/lounge to bedroom2/lounge partition chain now X=3600 mm. Existing stair/porch outer-wall centreline remains X=4175 mm (575 mm offset), not yet realigned: landing/18 risers/porch/slab coordination HOLD.

Room envelopes now nominal GF bath 3600×3800 mm, Bed2 3600×3400 mm, lounge 3600×7200 mm before wall face deductions. Fixtures/accessible clearances and door swing review REQUIRED; no IFC authorization.
FF lounge-side wall now X3600, geometrically matches GF in overlapping 7400 mm interval. Bearing/structural classification and support NOT verified.

FF main-bedroom/lounge door world X5800 retained; bath/Bed2 doors move 300 mm with their host; one centered internal stair window moves 150 mm. Finished jamb, egress, fixture clearance and safe glazing NOT verified.

GF/FF stair exterior centerline X4175 and outer face X4290 preserved; 575 mm from X3600. 18 nominal risers/3048 mm story, nominal 250 mm tread, 900 mm stair width; landing, guards, slab void and finished headroom HOLD.

No authenticated frame, slabs, beam/column continuity, foundation support, wall bearing classification or analyzed gravity/seismic transfer demands in architectural-only source. Cannot certify load path, structural regularity, capacity or construction issue.

Column-axis bubbles A/B/C and 1–5 map to 14 provisional 300 mm presentation markers per floor (not project structural-source columns). Grid crossing C1 has no modeled marker. Member/footing registration, structural frame capacity and foundation layout remain on HOLD.

Owner-requested large FF window centered C4–C2 on right exterior zero-setback wall is geometrically proposed, NOT legally/structurally/fire-approved. Do not issue for construction without boundary and external opening eligibility.
B1–B5 presentation markers moved to wall X3600 only. This is NOT an accepted structural column/support layout. B1 stair and all GF/FF beam/footing/seismic load paths require engineer approval.
Relocated lounge-to-main-bedroom interior door near B4 at proposed station X4150 mm. Check swings, circulation, furniture and structure; no issued plan.

Row 4 shifted 762 mm rear, attached 2D wall nodes, room boundaries, finish-floor strips, provisional 3D column markers and GF wardrobe coordinated. Column axes are NOT engineered RCC or design loads; beams, support continuity, MEP and doorway clearances require independent QA.

GF 2.1 x 1.5 m right-side window aligned below FF W009 at Z8219 and same 900 mm sill. Only nominal 127 mm site-side clearance; municipal, fire/privacy and structural lintel permissions are NOT established.

Owner requested 5 inch building move LEFT within unchanged 30x60 ft nominal plot. Exact right clearance 127mm. Site objects re-registered to fixed plot in displayed 3D. Site plan survey, exterior services and parking-fit remain unapproved.

v3.5 room extension was incorrect. v3.6 translates row 4,3,2,1 and connected blocks rearward 762mm, preserving depths of rooms between rows 4–3, 3–2, 2–1. Rear 4–5 block shrinks. Front facade recedes, front yard increases to 3126mm; rear setback stays 1524mm. MEP/structural/parking/window approvals remain HOLD.

2D floor partitions and corresponding presentation-only furniture, floor plates, stairs/roof and column markers updated. MEP connecting runs need engineering reroute; visual adjustments not valid services design. No approved foundation, beam, headroom, cadastral or setback certification.

Owner-directed 762mm front-footprint retreat changes source floor perimeter area 92.3629 → 87.05176 m² per modeled level (shoelace verified). Model display floor plate/roof remains nonstructural. Contractual built-up area, FAR, local measurement and survey remain unverified.

Owner-approved alternative tank envelope inside GF parking panel (nominal plot X6362..8762, Y3676..4776mm). Very tight margin to parking edges. No verified footings, cover load, excavation support, tank dimensions/capacity, groundwater uplift or safe desludging access.

An ordinary soak pit is not placed beneath habitable foundation soil. Its former depiction is retired in v3.7 option only. Sewer / treated effluent lawful disposal and all hydraulic pipes/inverts are UNDESIGNED; this is not a complete operating sanitation system.
Exterior WC architectural proxy is omitted from the option. Existing GF common bath is retained for WC function; actual access, capacity, ventilation and wet-room design require architect approval.
Owner approved concept only. Pokhara 2083 amendment/municipality interpretation, surveyed parcel, ROW, drinking water separation and site foundation evidence not verified. NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.
